title: Maintenance Window
summary: A maintenance banner in the reader's own time zone, with a countdown and a warning before starting a job that would be cut off.
description: Banner for planned downtime in the reader's time zone with a countdown that sharpens as it nears, a start button that warns when a long job would run into the window, and, during the window, a notice to keep unsaved edits plus a reload warning.
catches: Downtime shown in the wrong time zone: converted to the reader's
Starting a long job that maintenance would cut off
Reloading with unsaved changes during the window (beforeunload warning)
limits: Doesn't make your app read-only; it only tells users and warns on reload
Times come from your start and end props
The reload warning depends on the browser showing beforeunload prompts
a11y: Cut-off hint is a polite live region linked to the start button
Dismiss is a button; icons are aria-hidden
server: Reject writes during maintenance on the server with a clear error so clients can retry later.
mistakes: site down for maintenance lost work
